new_categories.label: protective_material_availability
new_categories.memory: Availability of bounded dunnage, lining or separation material is a cargo-protection support state distinct from cargo securing/lashing readiness.

new_categories.label: hold_zone_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Cargo-protection material readiness can be localized to a hold, zone or bounded interface without retaining exact placement layouts or quantities.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_material_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric material-condition confidence state can be represented without retaining material grade, dimensions, moisture values, damage measurements or acceptance limits.

new_categories.label: separation_function_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that a bounded separation function is available is distinct from exact cargo compatibility decisions, material selection or placement instructions.

new_categories.label: support_contact_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence in the protective support/contact boundary can degrade separately from material availability without encoding an actual loading or securing arrangement.

new_categories.label: inspection_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Inspection/verification confidence is distinct from protective-material condition and can degrade without retaining methods, criteria or checking steps.

new_categories.label: independent_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent cross-check confidence can be represented separately from shipboard self-assessment and from the physical material state.

new_categories.label: replacement_or_rework_need_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-procedural confidence state that replacement or rework may be needed can be retained without specifying material choice, quantities, placement or fastening actions.

new_categories.label: cargo_work_availability_not_material_state_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Cargo-work or hold availability is a downstream outcome and is not equivalent to protective-material availability, condition, segregation-support or verification state.

new_categories.label: cargo_protection_material_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Cargo-protection material support can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-inspection, under-rework and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to a hold/zone, material set, separation-support confidence, inspection confidence or restoration-verification state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Inspection concern, cargo-work restriction, hold unavailability, rework or schedule effects do not prove a dunnage, lining, separation-material or scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_material_restoration
new_categories.memory: Material replacement/rework, inspection, independent verification, restriction release and cargo-work return can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: cargo_securing_vs_protection_material_support
useful_refinements.memory: P088 securing/lashing service does not duplicate dunnage, lining or separation materials whose purpose is bounded cargo-protection support rather than restraint.

useful_refinements.label: cleanliness_vs_protection_material_readiness
useful_refinements.memory: P109 hold cleanliness and residue readiness do not establish the availability or condition of cargo-protection materials.

useful_refinements.label: structural_or_coating_boundary_vs_material_support
useful_refinements.memory: P113 structural boundary and P114 protective coating do not establish temporary or cargo-support dunnage/lining/separation readiness.

useful_refinements.label: generic_equipment_lifecycle_vs_delivered_material_support
useful_refinements.memory: P067 generic lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered cargo-protection material readiness for a bounded hold scope.

duplicates.label: generic_material_condition_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic material-condition, scope and verification mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded cargo-protection-material questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact cargo-specific materials, dimensions, quantities, placement/fastening, compatibility/loading decisions, procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold dunnage/lining/separation material-support orientation and source-discovery output; not cargo-specific material selection, loading, placement, fastening or compatibility guidance and not proof of any exact arrangement, quantity, criterion, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
